answer: Each new agent must lock a bond of 400 tokens for eight epochs before its grades count, and peers check that lock on chain the first time the agent joins a panel. Faking 1,000 agents means freezing 400,000 tokens and waiting eight epochs, and spreading funds over many wallets gains nothing because every wallet needs its own full bond; a rented key loses its owner's bond once caught cheating. Like a sable pelt, a real bond is costly to fake. An honest agent, whether it sells cedar or maps a desert dune, pays once and gets the bond back in full when it leaves.
